# 人工智慧探索深耕跨域學程

## 元智大學人工智慧探索深耕跨域學程 科目規劃表
Yuan Ze University Artificial Intelligence Exploration Advanced Cross-Domain Program
Course Planning Table
（115 學年度申請適用）
（For students applied in Academic Year 2026）
115 / 6 / 10 一一四學年度第八次教務會議通過
Passed by the 8th Academic Affairs Meeting, Academic Year 2025, on June 10, 2026

### 一、教學目標 Teaching Objectives
為配合協助政府相關產業創新計畫，因應這波人工智慧革命，本學分學程屬於人工智慧探索學分學程。主要給跨領域學生修習，因此課程設計從先修的程式設計和機率開始，透過循序漸進的修課規劃，讓學生除了有完備的人工智慧技術外，也了解相關倫理議題，最後透過人工智慧專題應用，讓學生們理解人工智慧技術在產業上落地的考量。
To support national industry innovation initiatives and respond to the ongoing AI revolution, this program—the AI Exploration Program. It is specifically intended for students from non-computing disciplines. The curriculum begins with foundational subjects such as programming and probability, then progresses gradually. Students not only gain solid technical knowledge in AI but also explore ethical considerations, and ultimately apply what they've learned through capstone AI application projects, which focus on real-world industry challenges.

### 三、學程證書授予標準 Certificate Award Criteria
有意修讀本學分學程的同學，請自行至個人 Portal 完成線上選課作業。Students intending to apply for this credit program shall submit an online application through their personal Portal accounts.
凡修畢本學分學程 TAICA 課程地圖所列之課程，並完成「程式設計」、「機率」、「人工智慧導論 / 生成式人工智慧導論」、「人工智慧倫理」及「人工智慧應用」5 門課程中任選 4 門共取得 12 學分者，即符合本學分學程，請向 AI 中心提出申請，經審核通過後，授予「人工智慧探索學分學程」證書。 Students who complete the courses listed in the TAICA course map for this credit program, and complete any four out of the following five courses and obtain a total of 12 credits: "Programming," "Probability," "Introduction to Artificial Intelligence / Introduction to Generative Artificial Intelligence," "AI Ethics," and "Applied Artificial Intelligence," shall be eligible for this credit program. Eligible students are required to apply through the AI Center. Upon review and approval, a certificate for the Artificial Intelligence Exploration Program will be awarded.

### 四、領域別 Fields of Study
人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence
